parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Data Transmission Service (DTS) instances. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The IDs of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instances. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the instance IDs.

> N specifies the serial number of the instance. For example, ResourceId.1 specifies the ID of the first instance and ResourceId.2 specifies the ID of the second instance.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE**.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags to be added to the instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE --resource-id dtsntk10k6r12v0000 --tag Value=testvalue1 Key=testkey1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 dtsntk10k6r12v0000 --Tag.1.Key testkey1 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --Tag.1.Value testvalue1 --ResourceType 'ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
